clips.title: The story
paras: Canaga Earthcaller is a Darkspear troll shaman stationed in the sunbaked Valley of Trials. He instructs novice Horde shamans in communing with the spirits of the land and obtaining their first elemental totems.

Perched on the red bluffs of the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller serves as one of the very first spiritual guides for Darkspear trolls and orcs who walk the path of the shaman. While many trainers focus strictly on martial readiness, Canaga teaches newcomers how to quiet their minds and listen to the rumblings of Kalimdor itself, preparing the earth sapta necessary to commune with the spirits.

Before any fledgling shaman can truly channel the elemental fury of the earth, they must prove their respect and resolve to the spirits. Canaga directs initiates to gather sacred reagents and journey to the local spirit rock in Durotar. Through his guidance, novices drink the earth sapta, behold the elemental spirits firsthand, and earn their Earth Totem.
